parameters.path: required nonempty ordinary local raw-file path
parameters.authoritative_copy: required primary or backup; never selected automatically
parameters.selection_decision_digest: optional nonzero lowercase sha256 digest declaration; required for two valid byte-disagreeing copies

effects: read-only file opens and bounded metadata reads/rereads; no output files, writes, mounting, physical access, broker, journal or durable operation

capture.geometry: file size must be a whole number of selected logical blocks and at least three blocks; capacity must fit checked byte space
capture.regions: full PMBR block; primary LBA1 block; backup final block; each advertised rounded array only when its own header establishes a valid bounded footprint
capture.target_header_crc: repair only a private header copy to derive array extents when CRC is the sole header issue; retain original bytes; never infer destroyed layout
capture.consistency: same ordinary-file/parent identity checks as image.inspect; every requested region reread; compare overlap, metadata and bytes; live-uncoordinated, not atomic snapshot or whole-file hash
capture.bindings: image_id is canonical source_before metadata SHA256; numeric epoch is started_filetime; provider transport supplies the owned bytes and their declared private capture digest; runtime independently recomputes that digest before planning; no independently approved prior capture is implied; this numeric wall-clock timestamp is not a globally unique/monotonic observation sequence; the separate opaque transport epoch binds process creation and capture sequence

result.capture: ordinary-file consistency receipt, epoch and region manifest digest; at most five region summaries
result.definition: unchanged immutable gpt-repair-preview-prototype/1 definition from the private planner; hashes/offsets/lengths/dependencies, no raw patch bytes
result.plan_digest: sha256 over canonical immutable definition only; excludes outer mutable transport timings
result.review: Reconstructed/bound definition per capture; identical immutable inputs may have the same digest. Transport observation epoch is distinct. A digest is not a replay ticket, approval, selection authentication or write authority.

invalid_syntax.diagnostics: existing CLI token diagnostics: missing_parameter, invalid_option_value, duplicate_option, unknown_option; typed stdio values use invalid_parameter/unexpected_parameter

outcomes.unresolved_wait: existing bounded image request policy; retain live callback until it settles; no replacement admission while occupied

frontends: same schema-generated forms and shared command dispatch in CLI, stdio, GUI, TUI and shell; viewing/reviewing a form does not open the source; essential help/discovery do not enumerate or open files

required: independent fixture bytes and patch hash/offset oracle
both authority directions; 512 and 4096 units; header/array damage and valid disagreement
malformed/truncated/changed/unsupported inputs; parameter and open guard ordering
CLI/stdio parity; GUI/TUI/shell journeys; exact source preservation and no output creation
clean native build, actual launches, import closure, full relevant regression campaign
